## Title / Summary
Short title and a concise bug description.

## Business Value / User Outcome
What impact this has on the user, workflow, or reliability.

## Scope
Affected area or workflow.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. ...
2. ...

## Expected Behavior
What should happen.

## Actual Behavior
What happens instead.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Bug is resolved in the affected flow
- [ ] Regression is covered or prevented where practical
- [ ] Relevant error handling or messaging is correct

## Dependencies and Assumptions
Any related conditions, environment details, or limitations.

## Security / Privacy / Data Considerations
Note only if relevant.

## Architecture / Design Considerations
Any relevant implementation or integration context.

## Testing Expectations
How the fix should be verified.

## Documentation Expectations
Any docs, release notes, or support updates needed.

## Definition of Ready Checks
- [ ] Impact is clear
- [ ] Scope is bounded
- [ ] Repro steps and expected/actual behavior are documented
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are testable
- [ ] Dependencies/assumptions are captured
- [ ] Security/data is considered if relevant
- [ ] Test approach is defined
- [ ] Documentation needs are identified
